facts_raw.Primary Value: Customer / Pilot Access + Network / Mentorship + PMF / GTM
facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: L-SPARK does not have a fund and does not invest; provides 6 months of B2B SaaS acceleration, mentors, investor days and enterprise connections.
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Performance-based: if company raises money during the 6-month program or following 12 months, L-SPARK receives 3% equity. If no funding is raised in that 18-month window, no program fee/equity is due.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Canadian-based B2B/B2B2C SaaS; market-ready viable product, proven need/traction, IP ownership, strong team, ready to scale with investment.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 已有可售 SaaS 产品；早期 revenue；enterprise pipeline；清晰 ICP 和 growth bottleneck。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Six-month program; weekly operational reviews, workshops and investor events. Based in Ottawa with events across Canada.
facts_raw.International Founder: Limited — Canadian-based companies prioritized/required for core SaaS Accelerator
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 不应作为 international→Canada 的无门槛项目推荐；需先满足 Canadian-based company 条件。
facts_raw.Application Status: Current cohort closed; year-round applications accepted for future cohorts
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: Core cohort applications close in August each year; year-round interest accepted
facts_raw.Application Materials: 简短在线申请；通过后进入筛选/Bootcamp/Selection Day。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: Official application; L-SPARK team follows up directly.
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 加拿大 B2B SaaS，有产品和早期客户/收入，希望扩大 enterprise sales、pilot 与融资。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 非加拿大公司；pre-idea / 无产品；纯消费型 app；没有 B2B SaaS 商业模式。
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：适合已经在加拿大落地的 B2B SaaS；不适合把它作为海外 founder 进入北美的首选路径。
